raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type
- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Related bug report — none. Refs #9641, which introduced this path. Found through code analysis and reproduced with constructed CPU training runs.

Teacher setup enables dynamic self-distillation capability even for ordinary reward-only batches. Using `_has_teacher` in the loss compatibility guard consequently rejects REAL, FIPO and off-policy sequence masking when the batch has no teacher log-probabilities.

Check the batch's teacher log-probabilities in both HF and Megatron. HF checks the original batch before dynamic loss chunking so teacher-active batches remain rejected even when chunk metadata is incomplete. Add regression coverage and paired documentation.

## Experiment results

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/train/test_grpo_inactive_teacher.py tests/train/test_grpo_reward_metrics.py tests/test_align/test_grpo_loss.py` passed all 57 tests. The 28 new cases produce 12 expected failures and 16 passes with the original production code.
- `.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --all-files` passed all 10 hooks. `git diff --check` and `.venv/bin/python -m pip check` passed.
- A standalone CPU experiment used the full SwiftRLHF pipeline with a randomly initialized tiny Qwen2, local prompts and constructed rewards. With `kl_in_reward=false` and `beta=0.04`, REAL, FIPO and off-policy masking each failed at the original guard and completed three optimizer steps after this change. The normal GRPO control produced identical losses, gradient norms and parameter-update magnitude before and after the change.
- Adding `teacher_prompt` produced real teacher log-probabilities and kept all three unsupported combinations rejected. The repository regression tests additionally cover train/eval and chunked/non-chunked batches using native tiny Qwen3 forwards and backward passes.
- An independent CPU Megatron loss-component check passed 19 configurations. It executed the actual setup/loss/FIPO/masking methods with single-rank communication fixtures. Full Megatron GPU training remains unverified.

AI assistance was used for code analysis, implementation and validation.

# Checklist

- [ ] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

@@ -684,6 +684,7 @@ reward模型参数将在PPO、GRPO中使用；teacher模型参数在GKD与GRPO
   - 注意：`gdpo` 模式不支持 `kl_in_reward=True`，若同时设置会自动将 `kl_in_reward` 设为 `False`。
   - GDPO 适用于多奖励优化场景：当使用多个奖励函数时，GDPO 会对每个奖励函数分别在组内进行标准化（减均值、除标准差），然后使用 `reward_weights` 进行加权求和，最后再进行批次级别的标准化。这种方式可以更好地保留各个奖励的相对差异，避免不同奖励组合坍塌成相同的 advantage 值。
 - teacher_kl_coef: OPD-RL中teacher_kl的系数，即 `adv_t = base_adv + teacher_kl_coef * teacher_kl`。默认为 1.0。
+  - 动态自蒸馏模式下，REAL/FIPO 和 `off_policy_sequence_mask_delta` 的兼容性限制适用于包含 teacher 对数概率的批次。纯奖励训练批次可以使用这些选项。
 - advantage_reweight: 优势重加权算法，默认为None（不启用）。可选项为 `rlsd`（[RLSD, Self-Distilled RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03128)）：利用 teacher 与 student 在相同采样 token 上的对数概率差异，将 GRPO 的序列级优势在 token 维度重新分配，即 `delta_t = logP_T(y_t) - logP_S(y_t)`、`w_t = exp(sign(A) * delta_t)`、`reweight = (1 - λ) + λ * clip(w_t)`、`A_hat_t = A * reweight`；reweight 恒为正，不会翻转环境奖励的符号。启用后需满足：已设置 `reward_funcs`（reweight 方向依赖优势符号 `sign(A)`），且数据集包含 `teacher_prompt` 列（特权 prompt，如 问题 + 参考解答/标准答案）；与 `use_liger_kernel`、`loss_type in [real, fipo]`、`off_policy_sequence_mask_delta`、`teacher_model_server` 不兼容。teacher 模式：不设置 `--teacher_model` 时为动态自蒸馏（teacher = 当前策略在特权 prompt 上打分）；设置 `--teacher_model <ckpt>` 时为冻结本地 teacher（在 no_grad 下打分，训练中不更新）。
 - rlsd_lambda: RLSD 混合权重，`reweight = (1 - λ) + λ * clip(w_t)`。`0` 退化为普通 GRPO，`1` 为完整 RLSD 重加权。取值需在 [0, 1]，默认为 0.5。
 - rlsd_reweight_clip_range: 证据权重裁剪范围 eps_w，将 `w_t = exp(sign(A) * delta_t)` 裁剪到 `[1 - eps_w, 1 + eps_w]`，避免 teacher/student 对数概率差异造成过大的倍率。需 >= 0，默认为 0.2。

@@ -701,6 +701,7 @@ The hyperparameters for the reward function can be found in the [Reward function
   - Note: `gdpo` mode does not support `kl_in_reward=True`. If both are set, `kl_in_reward` will be automatically set to `False`.
   - GDPO is designed for multi-reward optimization: When using multiple reward functions, GDPO normalizes each reward function separately within groups (subtract mean, divide by std), then performs weighted aggregation using `reward_weights`, and finally applies batch-level normalization. This approach better preserves the relative differences between rewards and prevents different reward combinations from collapsing into identical advantage values.
 - teacher_kl_coef: Coefficient for teacher KL in OPD-RL, i.e. `adv_t = base_adv + teacher_kl_coef * teacher_kl`. Default is 1.0.
+  - For dynamic self-distillation, the REAL/FIPO and `off_policy_sequence_mask_delta` restrictions apply to batches carrying teacher log-probabilities. Reward-only batches may use these options.
 - advantage_reweight: Advantage reweighting algorithm. Default is None (disabled). Option: `rlsd` ([RLSD, Self-Distilled RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03128)), which redistributes the per-sequence GRPO advantage across tokens using the teacher-vs-student log-probability gap on the same sampled tokens, i.e. `delta_t = logP_T(y_t) - logP_S(y_t)`, `w_t = exp(sign(A) * delta_t)`, `reweight = (1 - λ) + λ * clip(w_t)`, `A_hat_t = A * reweight`. The reweight is strictly positive and never flips the sign of the environment reward. When enabled it requires `reward_funcs` (the reweight direction uses `sign(A)`) and a `teacher_prompt` column in the dataset (the privileged prompt, e.g. question + reference solution / ground-truth answer); it is incompatible with `use_liger_kernel`, `loss_type in [real, fipo]`, `off_policy_sequence_mask_delta`, and `teacher_model_server`. Teacher modes: without `--teacher_model` it runs dynamic self-distillation (teacher = current policy scored on the privileged prompt); with `--teacher_model <ckpt>` it uses a frozen local teacher (scored under no_grad, never updated during training).
 - rlsd_lambda: RLSD mixing weight, `reweight = (1 - λ) + λ * clip(w_t)`. `0` reduces to plain GRPO, `1` is full RLSD reweighting. Must be in [0, 1]. Default is 0.5.
 - rlsd_reweight_clip_range: Evidence-weight clip range eps_w. Clips `w_t = exp(sign(A) * delta_t)` to `[1 - eps_w, 1 + eps_w]` to prevent overly large multipliers from the teacher/student log-prob gap. Must be >= 0. Default is 0.2.

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+import pytest
+import torch
+from accelerate import Accelerator
+from collections import defaultdict
+from transformers import Qwen3Config, Qwen3ForCausalLM
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from swift.rl_core.data import GRPOBatch
+from swift.rlhf_trainers.grpo_trainer import GRPOTrainer
+
+
+def _case(loss_type, off_policy_mask, training, chunk_size):
+    torch.manual_seed(42)
+    model = Qwen3ForCausalLM(
+        Qwen3Config(
+            vocab_size=16,
+            hidden_size=8,
+            intermediate_size=16,
+            num_hidden_layers=1,
+            num_attention_heads=2,
+            num_key_value_heads=1,
+            head_dim=4)).train(training)
+    trainer = object.__new__(GRPOTrainer)
+    trainer.model = model
+    trainer.args = SimpleNamespace(
+        per_device_train_batch_size=chunk_size,
+        per_device_eval_batch_size=chunk_size,
+        delta=None,
+        report_to=[],
+        gradient_accumulation_steps=1)
+    trainer.template = SimpleNamespace(padding_free=False, sequence_parallel_size=1)
+    trainer.accelerator = Accelerator(cpu=True)
+    trainer.compute_entropy = False
+    trainer.overlong_filter = False
+    trainer.beta = 0.0
+    trainer.kl_in_reward = False
+    trainer.rollout_importance_sampling_mode = None
+    trainer.log_rollout_offpolicy_metrics = False
+    trainer.disable_rollout_importance_sampling = False
+    trainer.importance_sampling_level = 'token'
+    trainer.loss_type = loss_type
+    trainer.off_policy_sequence_mask_delta = 0.5 if off_policy_mask else None
+    trainer.num_generations = 2
+    trainer.real_tau = 1.0
+    trainer.epsilon_low = trainer.epsilon_high = 0.2
+    trainer.fipo_gamma = 0.9
+    trainer.fipo_clip_range = None
+    trainer.fipo_safety_threshold = None
+    trainer.sdar_loss_coef = 0
+    trainer.chord_sft_iterator = None
+    trainer.dynamic_num_samples = True
+    trainer.is_multimodal = False
+    trainer.use_liger_loss = False
+    trainer.model_accepts_loss_kwargs = False
+    trainer.compute_loss_func = None
+    trainer.model_kwarg_keys = ['use_cache', 'logits_to_keep']
+    trainer.temperature = 1.0
+    trainer._metrics = {'train': defaultdict(list), 'eval': defaultdict(list)}
+    # The normal setup enables dynamic teacher capability without a teacher model.
+    trainer._setup_teacher()
+    assert trainer._is_dynamic_self_distillation and trainer._has_teacher
+    assert not trainer._has_teacher_explicit()
+    inputs = {
+        'input_ids': torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 5, 0], [1, 6, 7, 8], [1, 6, 9, 0]]),
+        'attention_mask': torch.tensor([[1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1, 0], [1, 1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1, 0]])
+    }
+    batch = GRPOBatch(
+        completion_mask=torch.tensor([[True, True], [True, False], [True, True], [True, False]]),
+        truncated_mask=torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.bool),
+        seq_lengths=torch.tensor([2, 1, 2, 1]),
+        advantages=torch.tensor([[1., 1.], [-1., -1.], [1., 1.], [-1., -1.]]),
+        num_items_in_batch=torch.tensor(6),
+        logits_to_keep=2)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        logps, _ = trainer._get_per_token_logps_and_entropies(model, inputs.copy(), batch)
+    batch.old_per_token_logps = logps - torch.tensor([[0.1], [-0.1], [0.05], [-0.05]])
+    return trainer, inputs, batch
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('loss_type,off_policy_mask', [('real', False), ('fipo', False), ('grpo', True),
+                                                       ('grpo', False)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('training', [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('chunk_size', [2, 4])
+def test_reward_only_batches_allow_dynamic_teacher_capability(loss_type, off_policy_mask, training, chunk_size):
+    trainer, inputs, batch = _case(loss_type, off_policy_mask, training, chunk_size)
+    assert batch.teacher_per_token_logps is None
+    loss = trainer.compute_loss(trainer.model, {'model_inputs': inputs, 'grpo_batch': batch})
+    loss.backward()
+    assert torch.isfinite(loss)
+    assert all(torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all() for parameter in trainer.model.parameters())
+    assert any(torch.count_nonzero(parameter.grad) > 0 for parameter in trainer.model.parameters())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('loss_type,off_policy_mask', [('real', False), ('fipo', False), ('grpo', True)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('training', [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('chunk_size', [2, 4])
+def test_active_teacher_keeps_unsupported_combinations_rejected(loss_type, off_policy_mask, training, chunk_size):
+    trainer, inputs, batch = _case(loss_type, off_policy_mask, training, chunk_size)
+    batch.teacher_per_token_logps = batch.old_per_token_logps.clone()
+    # Check the original batch before dynamic chunks can discard their teacher metadata.
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='OPD-RL'):
+        trainer.compute_loss(trainer.model, {'model_inputs': inputs, 'grpo_batch': batch})
